items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: we had a picture taken with Bill Haley and his band, my mother and my sister, LaVerne Baker, and a host o' other

ctx.x: So we went and played all up and down over in Australia. We made all the towns and all the cities. We stayed over there for about a month. So I bought me a bunch o' rings and stuff over there. I got a little badge [ ] from Australia. I got one of them right down in my house right now where I got it. I brought it to my mother.

So, before we left over, my mother and my sister and ever'body went to the airport with me, so we had a picture taken with Bill Haley and his band, my mother and my sister, LaVerne Baker, and a host o' other
